"""Illustrative 5-year DCF valuation model (educational demo, hypothetical inputs).

Company: NovaTech Analytics (hypothetical software/analytics firm)
Modules: DCF (perpetuity-growth + exit-multiple), sensitivity table,
         bull/base/bear scenario analysis, Monte Carlo simulation.

Pure standard library only; outputs printed to console and CSV files.
"""
import csv
import random
import statistics

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ASSUMPTIONS (USD millions unless otherwise noted)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
COMPANY = "NovaTech Analytics (hypothetical)"
BASE_YEAR = 2024
PROJ_YEARS = [2025, 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029]
BASE_REVENUE = 500.0            # FY2024 revenue
TAX_RATE = 0.21                 # statutory cash tax rate
DA_PCT_REV = 0.030              # D&A as % of revenue
CAPEX_PCT_REV = 0.035           # capex as % of revenue
NWC_PCT_REV = 0.08              # net working capital as % of revenue

# WACC building blocks
RF = 0.042                      # risk-free rate
ERP = 0.050                     # equity risk premium
BETA = 1.10
COD_PRETAX = 0.052              # pre-tax cost of debt
WE, WD = 0.85, 0.15             # market-value capital weights
WACC_BASE = WE * (RF + BETA * ERP) + WD * COD_PRETAX * (1 - TAX_RATE)

TERMINAL_GROWTH_BASE = 0.025
EXIT_EV_EBITDA = 12.0           # exit multiple (cross-check)
NET_DEBT = 150.0                # debt less cash
SHARES_OUT = 60.0               # diluted shares (millions)

# Base-case projection path (FY2025 -> FY2029)
GROWTH_BASE = [0.18, 0.15, 0.12, 0.10, 0.08]   # revenue growth per year
MARGIN_BASE = [0.130, 0.145, 0.160, 0.175, 0.190]  # EBIT margin per year

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HELPERS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def write_csv(name, header, rows):
    with open(name, "w", newline="") as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh)
        w.writerow(header)
        w.writerows(rows)
    print(f"   [saved] {name}")

def money(v):
    return f"{v:>13,.1f}"

def pct(v):
    return f"{v * 100:>7.2f}%"

def build_fcfs(rev0, growths, margins):
    """Return (rows, fcfs) where rows carry EBITDA/EBIT/etc per projected year."""
    rev = rev0
    fcfs, rows = [], []
    for y, g, m in zip(PROJ_YEARS, growths, margins):
        prev_rev = rev
        rev = rev * (1 + g)
        ebit = rev * m
        da = rev * DA_PCT_REV
        ebitda = ebit + da
        nopat = ebit * (1 - TAX_RATE)
        capex = rev * CAPEX_PCT_REV
        dnwc = (rev - prev_rev) * NWC_PCT_REV
        fcf = nopat + da - capex - dnwc
        fcfs.append(fcf)
        rows.append({"year": y, "growth": g, "margin": m, "revenue": rev,
                     "ebit": ebit, "ebitda": ebitda, "da": da, "nopat": nopat,
                     "capex": capex, "dnwc": dnwc, "fcf": fcf})
    return rows, fcfs

def discount_fcfs(fcfs, wacc):
    return sum(f / (1 + wacc) ** (i + 1) for i, f in enumerate(fcfs))

def perp_tv(last_fcf, g, wacc):
    return last_fcf * (1 + g) / (wacc - g)

def value_pg(fcfs, rows, wacc, g):
    """Perpetuity-growth valuation -> (EV, equity, price/share, PV FCF, TV)."""
    pv_fcf = discount_fcfs(fcfs, wacc)
    tv = perp_tv(fcfs[-1], g, wacc)
    ev = pv_fcf + tv / (1 + wacc) ** len(fcfs)
    eq = ev - NET_DEBT
    return ev, eq, eq / SHARES_OUT, pv_fcf, tv

def value_exit(fcfs, rows, wacc, multiple):
    """Exit-multiple valuation -> (EV, equity, price/share, PV FCF, TV)."""
    pv_fcf = discount_fcfs(fcfs, wacc)
    tv = rows[-1]["ebitda"] * multiple
    ev = pv_fcf + tv / (1 + wacc) ** len(fcfs)
    eq = ev - NET_DEBT
    return ev, eq, eq / SHARES_OUT, pv_fcf, tv

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. BASE-CASE DCF
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
print("=" * 92)
print(f"DCF MODEL  |  {COMPANY}")
print(f"Base revenue FY{BASE_YEAR}: $500.0m  |  Tax {TAX_RATE:.0%}  |  "
      f"Net debt ${NET_DEBT:.0f}m  |  Shares {SHARES_OUT:.0f}m")
print("=" * 92)

rows, fcfs = build_fcfs(BASE_REVENUE, GROWTH_BASE, MARGIN_BASE)

hdr = (f"{'Year':<6}{'Growth':>9}{'EBIT %':>9}{'Revenue':>13}{'EBITDA':>13}"
       f"{'EBIT':>13}{'NOPAT':>13}{'FCF':>13}")
print("\n[1] 5-Year Projections (USD millions)")
print(hdr)
print("-" * 92)
for r in rows:
    print(f"{r['year']:<6}{pct(r['growth'])}{pct(r['margin'])}"
          f"{money(r['revenue'])}{money(r['ebitda'])}"
          f"{money(r['ebit'])}{money(r['nopat'])}{money(r['fcf'])}")

wacc = WACC_BASE
ev_pg, eq_pg, px_pg, pv_fcf, tv_pg = value_pg(fcfs, rows, wacc, TERMINAL_GROWTH_BASE)
ev_x, eq_x, px_x, _, tv_x = value_exit(fcfs, rows, wacc, EXIT_EV_EBITDA)

print(f"\n[2] Valuation summary  (WACC = {wacc * 100:.2f}%: CoE {RF+BETA*ERP:.2f}% | "
      f"after-tax CoD {COD_PRETAX*(1-TAX_RATE)*100:.2f}% | {WE:.0%}E/{WD:.0%}D)")
print("-" * 92)
print(f"{'Method':<28}{'PV of FCFs':>13}{'Terminal value':>16}{'EV':>14}"
      f"{'Equity':>13}{'$/share':>10}")
print(f"{'Perpetuity growth (g=2.50%)':<28}{money(pv_fcf)}{money(tv_pg)}"
      f"{money(ev_pg)}{money(eq_pg)}{money(px_pg)}")
print(f"{'Exit EV/EBITDA 12.0x':<28}{money(pv_fcf)}{money(tv_x)}"
      f"{money(ev_x)}{money(eq_x)}{money(px_x)}")
print(f"\nImplied EV/EBITDA on FY2029 EBITDA: {ev_pg / rows[-1]['ebitda']:.1f}x "
      f"| FCF yield on EV: {fcfs[-1] / ev_pg * 100:.1f}%")

write_csv("dcf_projections.csv",
          ["year", "revenue_growth", "ebit_margin", "revenue", "ebitda", "ebit",
           "nopat", "capex", "dnwc", "fcf"],
          [[r["year"], f"{r['growth']:.4f}", f"{r['margin']:.4f}",
            f"{r['revenue']:.3f}", f"{r['ebitda']:.3f}", f"{r['ebit']:.3f}",
            f"{r['nopat']:.3f}", f"{r['capex']:.3f}", f"{r['dnwc']:.3f}",
            f"{r['fcf']:.3f}"] for r in rows])

write_csv("valuation_summary.csv",
          ["method", "wacc", "terminal_growth", "exit_multiple", "pv_fcfs",
           "terminal_value", "enterprise_value", "equity_value", "price_per_share"],
          [["perpetuity_growth", f"{wacc:.4f}", f"{TERMINAL_GROWTH_BASE:.4f}", "",
            f"{pv_fcf:.3f}", f"{tv_pg:.3f}", f"{ev_pg:.3f}", f"{eq_pg:.3f}", f"{px_pg:.3f}"],
           ["exit_multiple", f"{wacc:.4f}", "", f"{EXIT_EV_EBITDA:.2f}",
            f"{pv_fcf:.3f}", f"{tv_x:.3f}", f"{ev_x:.3f}", f"{eq_x:.3f}", f"{px_x:.3f}"]])

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. SENSITIVITY: price/share across WACC x terminal growth
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"\n[3] Sensitivity of equity value per share (USD) - perpetuity-growth method")
wacc_axis = [0.080, 0.085, 0.090, 0.095, 0.100, 0.105, 0.110]
g_axis = [0.015, 0.020, 0.025, 0.030, 0.035]

def sens_price(w, g):
    ev, eq, px, _, _ = value_pg(fcfs, rows, w, g)
    return px

grid = [[sens_price(w, g) for g in g_axis] for w in wacc_axis]
print(f"{'WACC \\\\ g':<12}" + "".join(f"{g * 100:>9.1f}%" for g in g_axis))
print("-" * 92)
for w, line in zip(wacc_axis, grid):
    print(f"{w * 100:<11.2f}%" + "".join(f"{v:>10,.2f}" for v in line))

sens_rows = []
for i, w in enumerate(wacc_axis):
    for j, g in enumerate(g_axis):
        sens_rows.append([f"{w*100:.2f}%", f"{g*100:.1f}%", f"{grid[i][j]:.2f}"])
write_csv("sensitivity_table.csv",
          ["wacc", "terminal_growth", "price_per_share"], sens_rows)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. SCENARIO ANALYSIS (bull / base / bear)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"\n[4] Scenario analysis (probability-weighted)")
scen = {
    "Bear (25%)": dict(growths=[0.08, 0.06, 0.05, 0.04, 0.03],
                       margins=[0.115, 0.125, 0.135, 0.145, 0.155],
                       wacc=wacc + 0.0075, g=0.015, w=0.25),
    "Base (50%)": dict(growths=GROWTH_BASE, margins=MARGIN_BASE,
                       wacc=wacc, g=TERMINAL_GROWTH_BASE, w=0.50),
    "Bull (25%)": dict(growths=[0.22, 0.19, 0.16, 0.14, 0.12],
                       margins=[0.145, 0.165, 0.185, 0.200, 0.215],
                       wacc=wacc - 0.005, g=0.030, w=0.25),
}
print(f"{'Scenario':<16}{'Prob':>7}{'WACC':>8}{'g':>7}{'Revenue 29':>13}"
      f"{'EV':>14}{'Equity':>13}{'$/share':>10}")
print("-" * 92)
scen_rows, exp_px = [], 0.0
for name, s in scen.items():
    s_rows, s_fcfs = build_fcfs(BASE_REVENUE, s["growths"], s["margins"])
    ev, eq, px, _, _ = value_pg(s_fcfs, s_rows, s["wacc"], s["g"])
    exp_px += s["w"] * px
    print(f"{name:<16}{pct(s['w'])}{pct(s['wacc'])}{pct(s['g'])}"
          f"{money(s_rows[-1]['revenue'])}{money(ev)}{money(eq)}{money(px)}")
    scen_rows.append([name, f"{s['w']:.2f}", f"{s['wacc']*100:.2f}%",
                      f"{s['g']*100:.2f}%", f"{s_rows[-1]['revenue']:.1f}",
                      f"{ev:.1f}", f"{eq:.1f}", f"{px:.2f}"])
print(f"\nProbability-weighted expected value per share: ${exp_px:,.2f}")
scen_rows.append(["probability_weighted", "", "", "", "", "", "",
                  f"{exp_px:.2f}"])
write_csv("scenario_analysis.csv",
          ["scenario", "probability", "wacc", "terminal_growth",
           "revenue_2029", "enterprise_value", "equity_value",
           "price_per_share"], scen_rows)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. MONTE CARLO SIMULATION
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"\n[5] Monte Carlo simulation (5,000 iterations)")
N_MC = 5000
random.seed(2024)
mc_prices, mc_evs = [], []
for _ in range(N_MC):
    growths = [max(0.0, g + random.gauss(0.0, 0.035)) for g in GROWTH_BASE]
    margins = [min(0.30, max(0.08, m + random.gauss(0.0, 0.010)))
               for m in MARGIN_BASE]
    w = max(0.06, random.gauss(wacc, 0.005))
    g = random.gauss(TERMINAL_GROWTH_BASE, 0.004)
    while w - g < 0.005:                       # keep TV well-behaved
        w = max(0.06, random.gauss(wacc, 0.005))
        g = random.gauss(TERMINAL_GROWTH_BASE, 0.004)
    s_rows, s_fcfs = build_fcfs(BASE_REVENUE, growths, margins)
    ev, eq, px, _, _ = value_pg(s_fcfs, s_rows, w, g)
    mc_prices.append(px)
    mc_evs.append(ev)

mc_prices.sort()
mean_px = statistics.mean(mc_prices)
med_px = statistics.median(mc_prices)
stdev_px = statistics.stdev(mc_prices)
def pctl(p):
    return mc_prices[min(len(mc_prices) - 1, int(p * len(mc_prices)))]

p5, p25, p75, p95 = pctl(0.05), pctl(0.25), pctl(0.75), pctl(0.95)
p_above_base = sum(1 for v in mc_prices if v > px_pg) / N_MC
p_below_20 = sum(1 for v in mc_prices if v < 20.0) / N_MC

print(f"{'Statistic':<24}{'Value':>12}")
print("-" * 92)
print(f"{'Mean price/share':<24}{money(mean_px)}")
print(f"{'Median price/share':<24}{money(med_px)}")
print(f"{'Std deviation':<24}{money(stdev_px)}")
print(f"{'5th / 95th percentile':<24}{money(p5)} /{money(p95)}")
print(f"{'25th / 75th percentile':<24}{money(p25)} /{money(p75)}")
print(f"{'P(price > base-case $/sh)':<24}{pct(p_above_base)}")
print(f"{'P(price < $20.00)':<24}{pct(p_below_20)}")

write_csv("monte_carlo_results.csv",
          ["price_per_share", "enterprise_value"],
          [[f"{p:.3f}", f"{e:.3f}"] for p, e in zip(mc_prices, mc_evs)])
write_csv("monte_carlo_summary.csv",
          ["metric", "value"],
          [["mean_price", f"{mean_px:.3f}"], ["median_price", f"{med_px:.3f}"],
           ["std_dev", f"{stdev_px:.3f}"], ["p5", f"{p5:.3f}"],
           ["p25", f"{p25:.3f}"], ["p75", f"{p75:.3f}"],
           ["p95", f"{p95:.3f}"], ["prob_above_base", f"{p_above_base:.4f}"],
           ["prob_below_20", f"{p_below_20:.4f}"]])

print("\n" + "=" * 92)
print("Model checks: TV% of EV (pg method) = "
      f"{tv_pg / (1 + wacc) ** len(fcfs) / ev_pg * 100:.1f}% | "
      f"Base WACC {wacc*100:.2f}% > terminal g {TERMINAL_GROWTH_BASE*100:.2f}%  OK")
print("All output CSVs written to working directory.")
print("=" * 92)

"""
DCF Valuation Model - Demonstration Build
==========================================
A self-contained Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) engine for a hypothetical
mid-cap software company ("Acme Software, Inc."), following the Creating
Financial Models suite best practices:

  * Assumptions / inputs are isolated at the top (easy to edit).
  * Calculations are separated from assumptions.
  * Outputs are printed as formatted tables.
  * Quality checks (EBIT bridge, PV sanity) are built in.

Run:    python3 dcf_valuation_model.py
Requires: Python 3.8+ (standard library only, no third-party packages).

The model includes:
  1. Five-year explicit forecast
  2. Free cash flow (FCF) build
  3. WACC estimation (CAPM for cost of equity)
  4. Terminal value (perpetuity-growth method)
  5. Enterprise value -> equity value bridge
  6. Bear / Base / Bull scenario comparison (probability weighted)
  7. Two-way sensitivity table (WACC vs. terminal growth rate)

DISCLAIMER: Illustrative model only, built for demonstration. Not
investment advice; outputs are only as good as the assumptions entered.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. ASSUMPTIONS  (edit everything below this banner)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

COMPANY = "Acme Software, Inc. (illustrative)"

# ---- Historical anchor -----------------------------------------------------
last_revenue = 500.0        # $ millions, most recent fiscal year
ebitda_margin_last = 0.22   # 22% EBITDA margin in the anchor year
da_last = 35.0              # D&A in the anchor year ($m)

# ---- Forecast drivers (one value per forecast year, year 1 = FY+1) ---------
rev_growth    = [0.25, 0.20, 0.16, 0.12, 0.09]  # revenue growth y/y
ebit_margin   = [0.12, 0.14, 0.16, 0.18, 0.19]  # EBIT margin
da_pct_rev    = [0.06, 0.06, 0.05, 0.05, 0.04]  # D&A as % of revenue
capex_pct_rev = [0.07, 0.07, 0.06, 0.05, 0.05]  # capex as % of revenue
nwc_pct_rev   = [0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02]  # annual change in NWC as % of revenue

tax_rate = 0.21

# ---- WACC inputs -----------------------------------------------------------
risk_free_rate     = 0.042   # 10Y government bond yield
equity_risk_premium = 0.055  # market risk premium
beta               = 1.15    # levered equity beta
cost_of_debt       = 0.050   # pre-tax cost of debt
debt_weight        = 0.15    # target D / (D + E)
equity_weight      = 1.0 - debt_weight

# ---- Terminal value --------------------------------------------------------
terminal_growth = 0.025      # perpetual growth rate (nominal)

# ---- Equity bridge ---------------------------------------------------------
cash              = 120.0    # excess cash on balance sheet ($m)
debt              = 250.0    # total debt ($m)
shares_outstanding = 90.0    # fully diluted shares (millions)

# ---- Scenario definitions --------------------------------------------------
# rev_mult      : scales the entire revenue path (size of the business)
# margin_shift  : additive shift to every EBIT margin forecast
# terminal_growth : perpetual growth assumption for that scenario
# prob          : subjective probability weight (must sum to 1.0)
scenarios = {
    "Bear": {"rev_mult": 0.80, "margin_shift": -0.03, "terminal_growth": 0.015, "prob": 0.25},
    "Base": {"rev_mult": 1.00, "margin_shift":  0.00, "terminal_growth": 0.025, "prob": 0.50},
    "Bull": {"rev_mult": 1.20, "margin_shift": +0.03, "terminal_growth": 0.035, "prob": 0.25},
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CALCULATION ENGINE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def compute_wacc() -> float:
    """Weighted average cost of capital using CAPM for equity."""
    cost_equity = risk_free_rate + beta * equity_risk_premium
    cost_debt_after_tax = cost_of_debt * (1.0 - tax_rate)
    return debt_weight * cost_debt_after_tax + equity_weight * cost_equity


def build_forecast(rev_growth: list, ebit_margin: list, da_pct_rev: list,
                   capex_pct_rev: list, nwc_pct_rev: list,
                   rev_mult: float = 1.0, margin_shift: float = 0.0,
                   start_revenue: float = last_revenue) -> dict:
    """
    Project revenues, EBIT, and free cash flow for 5 years.

    FCF = EBIT * (1 - tax) + D&A - CapEx - change in NWC
    """
    n = len(rev_growth)
    revenues, ebits, das, capex, dnwc, fcfs = [], [], [], [], [], []

    revenue = start_revenue
    for i in range(n):
        revenue = revenue * (1.0 + rev_growth[i])
        revenues.append(revenue * rev_mult)

        margin = min(0.45, max(0.01, ebit_margin[i] + margin_shift))
        ebits.append(revenues[-1] * margin)
        das.append(revenues[-1] * da_pct_rev[i])
        capex.append(revenues[-1] * capex_pct_rev[i])
        dnwc.append(revenues[-1] * nwc_pct_rev[i])

        nopat = ebits[-1] * (1.0 - tax_rate)
        fcfs.append(nopat + das[-1] - capex[-1] - dnwc[-1])

    return {
        "revenues": revenues, "ebits": ebits, "da": das,
        "capex": capex, "dnwc": dnwc, "fcfs": fcfs,
    }


def run_model(rev_growth: list, ebit_margin: list, wacc: float,
              terminal_growth: float, rev_mult: float = 1.0,
              margin_shift: float = 0.0) -> dict:
    """Full DCF: forecast, discount FCF + terminal value, equity bridge."""
    fc = build_forecast(rev_growth, ebit_margin, da_pct_rev, capex_pct_rev,
                        nwc_pct_rev, rev_mult, margin_shift)

    n = len(fc["fcfs"])
    pv_fcfs, disc_factors = [], []
    for t in range(n):
        df = 1.0 / ((1.0 + wacc) ** (t + 1))          # end-of-year discounting
        disc_factors.append(df)
        pv_fcfs.append(fc["fcfs"][t] * df)

    fcf_final = fc["fcfs"][-1]
    if wacc <= terminal_growth:
        raise ValueError("WACC must exceed terminal growth for a finite TV.")

    tv = fcf_final * (1.0 + terminal_growth) / (wacc - terminal_growth)
    pv_tv = tv * disc_factors[-1]

    enterprise_value = sum(pv_fcfs) + pv_tv
    equity_value = enterprise_value + cash - debt
    per_share = equity_value / shares_outstanding

    return {
        "fc": fc, "pv_fcfs": pv_fcfs, "disc_factors": disc_factors,
        "tv": tv, "pv_tv": pv_tv, "enterprise_value": enterprise_value,
        "equity_value": equity_value, "per_share": per_share,
        "wacc": wacc, "terminal_growth": terminal_growth,
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. OUTPUT / REPORTING HELPERS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def fmt_money(x: float) -> str:
    return f"${x:>12,.1f}"


def fmt_pct(x: float) -> str:
    return f"{x * 100:>6.2f}%"


def print_forecast_table(result: dict) -> None:

    print(header)
    print("-" * len(header))

    rows = [
        ("Revenue", fc["revenues"], "{:>14,.1f}"),
        ("EBIT", fc["ebits"], "{:>14,.1f}"),
        ("+ D&A", fc["da"], "{:>14,.1f}"),
        ("- CapEx", fc["capex"], "{:>14,.1f}"),
        ("- dNWC", fc["dnwc"], "{:>14,.1f}"),
        ("FCF", fc["fcfs"], "{:>14,.1f}"),
        ("PV of FCF", result["pv_fcfs"], "{:>14,.1f}"),
    ]
    for label, values, fmt in rows:
        print(f"{label:<16}" + "".join(fmt.format(v) for v in values))

    fcf_y1 = fc["fcfs"][0]

    print("-" * len(header))
    print(f"FCF CAGR (yr1 -> yr5): {fcf_gr * 100:,.1f}%")

def print_valuation_summary(result: dict) -> None:

    # Implied exit multiple check (enterprise value / final-year EBITDA proxy)
    final_ebit = fc["ebits"][-1]

    print(f"Quality check - TV % of enterprise value : "

def print_scenario_analysis() -> None:
    print("=" * 72)
    print("SCENARIO ANALYSIS  (probability-weighted)")
    print("=" * 72)
    base_wacc = compute_wacc()
    weighted_ps = 0.0

    header = f"{'Scenario':<8}{'Prob':>8}{'WACC':>8}{'Term g':>8}" \

              f"{s['terminal_growth'] * 100:>7.2f}%"

              f"{res['equity_value']:>14,.1f}"
              f"{res['per_share']:>12,.2f}")

    print(f"{'Weighted':<8}{prob_sum * 100:>7.0f}%"
          f"{'':>30}{'':>14}{weighted_ps:>12,.2f}")
    print()


def print_sensitivity() -> None:
    print("=" * 72)
    print("SENSITIVITY TABLE - Equity value per share ($)")

    print(header)

    for w in wacc_range:

def quality_checks() -> None:

    print("=" * 72)
    checks_ok = True

    # 1) Number of forecast years is consistent across driver lists
    n = len(rev_growth)

    if any(len(x) != n for x in lists):

    ok = abs(prob_sum - 1.0) < 1e-9
    checks_ok = checks_ok and ok

    # 3) Terminal growth is below WACC
    w = compute_wacc()

    res = run_model(rev_growth, ebit_margin, w, terminal_growth)

    checks_ok = checks_ok and ok
    print(f"  [{'OK' if ok else 'FAIL'}]   FCF rebuild matches FCF build (EBIT bridge).")

    # 5) PV of terminal value is a reasonable share of EV (20%-90% band)
    tv_share = res["pv_tv"] / res["enterprise_value"]
    ok = 0.20 <= tv_share <= 0.90
    checks_ok = checks_ok and ok
    print(f"  [{'OK' if ok else 'FAIL'}]   TV share of EV is {tv_share:.1%} "
          f"(expected within 20%-90%).")

    print()
    if not checks_ok:
        print("Some checks failed - review assumptions before relying on output.\n")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. MAIN
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main() -> None:
    wacc = compute_wacc()
    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print(f"DCF VALUATION MODEL - {COMPANY}")
    print("=" * 72)
    print(f"Assumed WACC = {wacc * 100:.2f}%  "
          f"(Ke = {(risk_free_rate + beta * equity_risk_premium) * 100:.2f}%, "
          f"Kd(a/t) = {cost_of_debt * (1 - tax_rate) * 100:.2f}%, "
          f"wE = {equity_weight * 100:.0f}%, wD = {debt_weight * 100:.0f}%)")

    print("-" * 72)

    print_scenario_analysis()
    print_sensitivity()
    quality_checks()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Company DCF Valuation Model
===========================

A complete, self-contained Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model for a fictional
company called "NovaCorp Analytics".  Built exclusively on the Python
standard library (no third-party packages required).

What the model does
-------------------
  1. Projects 5 years of unlevered free cash flow (UFCF) from explicit
     assumptions for revenue growth, EBIT margin, D&A, capex and working
     capital.
  2. Builds the weighted average cost of capital (WACC) from CAPM inputs.
  3. Values the terminal period with the Gordon perpetuity-growth method.
  4. Bridges enterprise value -> equity value -> value per share.
  5. Prints implied valuation multiples (EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDA).
  6. Compares Best / Base / Worst scenarios (with probability weighting).
  7. Runs a two-way sensitivity table on WACC x terminal growth.

Run it with:

    python3 company_dcf_valuation_model.py

All monetary figures are in $ millions unless otherwise stated.  Value per
share is in dollars.  This is an educational model for illustration only and
is not investment advice.
"""

# ======================================================================
# ASSUMPTIONS  (edit this section to value a different company)
# ======================================================================

BASE = {
    # ---- Explicit forecast period (years 1..5) -----------------------
    "revenue_0": 100.0,          # last historical year revenue ($M)
    "growth_rates": [0.12, 0.11, 0.10, 0.09, 0.08],
    "ebit_margins": [0.13, 0.14, 0.15, 0.16, 0.17],
    "tax_rate": 0.25,            # cash tax rate on EBIT

    # ---- Cash-flow drivers (as % of revenue unless noted) ------------
    "da_pct_revenue": 0.030,                 # depreciation & amortisation
    "capex_pct_revenue": 0.045,              # capital expenditure
    "nwc_pct_incremental_revenue": 0.20,     # NWC build on revenue growth

    # ---- WACC inputs -------------------------------------------------
    "risk_free": 0.040,          # 10-year government bond yield
    "beta": 1.15,                # levered equity beta
    "equity_risk_premium": 0.050,
    "cost_of_debt_pretax": 0.055,
    "equity_weight": 0.75,
    "debt_weight": 0.25,

    # ---- Terminal value & capital structure --------------------------
    "terminal_growth": 0.025,    # perpetuity growth rate
    "cash": 12.0,                # excess cash on balance sheet ($M)
    "debt": 40.0,                # total interest-bearing debt ($M)
    "shares": 12.5,              # diluted shares outstanding (millions)
}


# ======================================================================
# CALCULATIONS
# ======================================================================

def cost_of_equity(p):
    """CAPM: ke = risk-free + beta * equity risk premium."""
    return p["risk_free"] + p["beta"] * p["equity_risk_premium"]


def wacc(p, discount_override=None):
    """Weighted average cost of capital (or an override discount rate)."""
    if discount_override is not None:
        return discount_override
    ke = cost_of_equity(p)
    kd_after_tax = p["cost_of_debt_pretax"] * (1.0 - p["tax_rate"])
    return p["equity_weight"] * ke + p["debt_weight"] * kd_after_tax


def project_fcfs(p):
    """Project five years of revenue, EBIT and unlevered free cash flow."""
    rows = []
    revenue = p["revenue_0"]
    for year, (g, margin) in enumerate(
            zip(p["growth_rates"], p["ebit_margins"]), start=1):
        revenue_prev = revenue
        revenue = revenue_prev * (1.0 + g)
        ebit = revenue * margin
        nopat = ebit * (1.0 - p["tax_rate"])
        da = revenue * p["da_pct_revenue"]
        capex = revenue * p["capex_pct_revenue"]
        nwc_change = p["nwc_pct_incremental_revenue"] * (revenue - revenue_prev)
        ufcf = nopat + da - capex - nwc_change
        rows.append({
            "year": year,
            "revenue": revenue,
            "ebit": ebit,
            "nopat": nopat,
            "da": da,
            "capex": capex,
            "nwc_change": nwc_change,
            "ufcf": ufcf,
        })
    return rows


def run_valuation(p, discount_override=None, terminal_growth_override=None):
    """Run the full DCF and return a dictionary of results."""
    rows = project_fcfs(p)
    rate = wacc(p, discount_override)
    g = p["terminal_growth"] if terminal_growth_override is None else terminal_growth_override
    if g >= rate:
        raise ValueError("Terminal growth must be below the discount rate.")

    pv_fcfs = [row["ufcf"] / (1.0 + rate) ** row["year"] for row in rows]
    last_fcf = rows[-1]["ufcf"]
    terminal_value = last_fcf * (1.0 + g) / (rate - g)
    pv_terminal_value = terminal_value / (1.0 + rate) ** len(rows)

    enterprise_value = sum(pv_fcfs) + pv_terminal_value
    equity_value = enterprise_value + p["cash"] - p["debt"]
    per_share = equity_value / p["shares"]

    first_ebitda = rows[0]["ebit"] + rows[0]["da"]

    return {
        "rows": rows,
        "discount_rate": rate,
        "terminal_growth": g,
        "pv_fcfs": pv_fcfs,
        "sum_pv_fcfs": sum(pv_fcfs),
        "terminal_value": terminal_value,
        "pv_terminal_value": pv_terminal_value,
        "enterprise_value": enterprise_value,
        "equity_value": equity_value,
        "per_share": per_share,
        "ev_revenue_y1": enterprise_value / rows[0]["revenue"],
        "ev_ebitda_y1": enterprise_value / first_ebitda,
    }


# ======================================================================
# REPORTING
# ======================================================================

def print_report(res, p, label="Base case"):
    """Print the full DCF valuation report for one scenario."""
    rows = res["rows"]
    rate = res["discount_rate"]
    print("\n" + "=" * 96)
    print("DCF VALUATION REPORT  -  {}".format(label))
    print("=" * 96)

    ke = cost_of_equity(p)
    kd_after_tax = p["cost_of_debt_pretax"] * (1.0 - p["tax_rate"])
    print("\n--- WACC build-up ---")
    print("  Cost of equity (CAPM)          : {:>7.2%}".format(ke))
    print("  Cost of debt (after tax)       : {:>7.2%}".format(kd_after_tax))
    print("  WACC                           : {:>7.2%}".format(rate))

    print("\n--- Five-year projection ($M) ---")
    print("{:>5} {:>11} {:>11} {:>11} {:>10} {:>10} {:>10} {:>11}".format(
        "Year", "Revenue", "EBIT", "NOPAT", "+D&A", "-CapEx", "-dNWC", "UFCF"))
    for row in rows:
        print("{:>5} {:>11,.2f} {:>11,.2f} {:>11,.2f} {:>10,.2f} "
              "{:>10,.2f} {:>10,.2f} {:>11,.2f}".format(
                  row["year"], row["revenue"], row["ebit"], row["nopat"],
                  row["da"], row["capex"], row["nwc_change"], row["ufcf"]))

    print("\n--- DCF bridge ($M) ---")
    print("  Sum of PV of UFCF (years 1-5)  : {:>11,.2f}".format(res["sum_pv_fcfs"]))
    print("  Terminal value (year 5, g={:.1%})".format(res["terminal_growth"]))
    print("    Terminal value               : {:>11,.2f}".format(res["terminal_value"]))
    print("    PV of terminal value         : {:>11,.2f}".format(res["pv_terminal_value"]))
    print("  Enterprise value               : {:>11,.2f}".format(res["enterprise_value"]))
    print("  Less: net debt (debt - cash)   : {:>11,.2f}".format(p["debt"] - p["cash"]))
    print("  Equity value                   : {:>11,.2f}".format(res["equity_value"]))
    print("  Diluted shares (millions)      : {:>11,.2f}".format(p["shares"]))
    print("  Value per share ($)            : {:>11,.2f}".format(res["per_share"]))
    print("\n--- Implied valuation multiples (using year-1 figures) ---")
    print("  EV / Revenue (Y1)              : {:>10.2f}x".format(res["ev_revenue_y1"]))
    print("  EV / EBITDA (Y1)               : {:>10.2f}x".format(res["ev_ebitda_y1"]))


def print_scenarios():
    """Best / Base / Worst scenario comparison with probability weighting."""
    print("\n" + "=" * 96)
    print("SCENARIO ANALYSIS")
    print("=" * 96)
    print("  Best : faster growth (16-12%), margins to 20%, g = 3.0%")
    print("  Base : reference assumptions above,              g = 2.5%")
    print("  Worst: slower growth (6-4%),  margins to 13%,    g = 2.0%")

    best = dict(BASE)
    best["growth_rates"] = [0.16, 0.15, 0.14, 0.13, 0.12]
    best["ebit_margins"] = [0.16, 0.17, 0.18, 0.19, 0.20]
    best["terminal_growth"] = 0.030

    worst = dict(BASE)
    worst["growth_rates"] = [0.06, 0.06, 0.05, 0.05, 0.04]
    worst["ebit_margins"] = [0.10, 0.11, 0.12, 0.12, 0.13]
    worst["terminal_growth"] = 0.020

    scenarios = [
        (0.25, "Worst case", worst),
        (0.50, "Base case ", BASE),
        (0.25, "Best case ", best),
    ]

    print("\n{:>13} {:>13} {:>13} {:>12} {:>13}".format(
        "Scenario", "EV ($M)", "Equity ($M)", "$/share", "EV/EBITDA"))
    weighted_ps = 0.0
    for prob, name, params in scenarios:
        res = run_valuation(params)
        weighted_ps += prob * res["per_share"]
        print("{:>13} {:>13,.2f} {:>13,.2f} {:>12,.2f} {:>13,.2f}".format(
            name, res["enterprise_value"], res["equity_value"],
            res["per_share"], res["ev_ebitda_y1"]))
    print("-" * 96)
    print("{:>13} {:>13} {:>13} {:>12,.2f}".format(
        "Probability-weighted", "", "", weighted_ps))


def print_sensitivity(p):
    """Two-way sensitivity of equity value per share to WACC x terminal g."""
    growths = [0.015, 0.020, 0.025, 0.030, 0.035]
    rates = [0.070, 0.075, 0.080, 0.085, 0.090, 0.095]

    print("\n" + "=" * 96)
    print("SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS - Equity value per share ($)")

          "(value {:.2f})".format(run_valuation(p)["per_share"]))
    print("\n{:>11}  {}".format("WACC \\ g", "".join(
        "{:>11}".format("{:.1%}".format(g)) for g in growths)))
    for r in rates:
        cells = []
        for g in growths:
            cells.append(run_valuation(p, discount_override=r,
                                       terminal_growth_override=g)["per_share"])
        print("{:>11}  {}".format("{:.2%}".format(r),
                                  "".join("{:>11,.2f}".format(v) for v in cells)))


# ======================================================================
# MAIN
# ======================================================================

def main():
    print("=" * 96)
    print("COMPANY DCF VALUATION MODEL - NovaCorp Analytics (illustrative)")
    print("=" * 96)

    base_result = run_valuation(BASE)
    print_report(base_result, BASE)
    print_scenarios()
    print_sensitivity(BASE)

    print("\n" + "=" * 96)
    print("END OF MODEL")
    print("=" * 96)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

CAPEX_PCT_REV = 0.035           # capex as % of revenue
NWC_PCT_REV = 0.08              # net working capital as % of revenue

# WACC building blocks
RF = 0.042                      # risk-free rate
ERP = 0.050                     # equity risk premium
BETA = 1.10
COD_PRETAX = 0.052              # pre-tax cost of debt
WE, WD = 0.85, 0.15             # market-value capital weights
WACC_BASE = WE * (RF + BETA * ERP) + WD * COD_PRETAX * (1 - TAX_RATE)

TERMINAL_GROWTH_BASE = 0.025
EXIT_EV_EBITDA = 12.0           # exit multiple (cross-check)
NET_DEBT = 150.0                # debt less cash

# Base-case projection path (FY2025 -> FY2029)

def write_csv(name, header, rows):
    with open(name, "w", newline="") as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh)
        w.writerow(header)
        w.writerows(rows)
    print(f"   [saved] {name}")

def money(v):
    return f"{v:>13,.1f}"

def pct(v):
    return f"{v * 100:>7.2f}%"

def build_fcfs(rev0, growths, margins):
    """Return (rows, fcfs) where rows carry EBITDA/EBIT/etc per projected year."""
    rev = rev0
    fcfs, rows = [], []
    for y, g, m in zip(PROJ_YEARS, growths, margins):
        prev_rev = rev
        rev = rev * (1 + g)
        ebit = rev * m
        da = rev * DA_PCT_REV
        ebitda = ebit + da
        nopat = ebit * (1 - TAX_RATE)
        capex = rev * CAPEX_PCT_REV
        dnwc = (rev - prev_rev) * NWC_PCT_REV
        fcf = nopat + da - capex - dnwc

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Company DCF Valuation Model
===========================

A complete, self-contained Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model for a fictional
company called "NovaCorp Analytics".  Built exclusively on the Python
standard library (no third-party packages required).

What the model does
-------------------
  1. Projects 5 years of unlevered free cash flow (UFCF) from explicit
     assumptions for revenue growth, EBIT margin, D&A, capex and working
     capital.
  2. Builds the weighted average cost of capital (WACC) from CAPM inputs.
  3. Values the terminal period with the Gordon perpetuity-growth method.
  4. Bridges enterprise value -> equity value -> value per share.
  5. Prints implied valuation multiples (EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDA).
  6. Compares Best / Base / Worst scenarios (with probability weighting).
  7. Runs a two-way sensitivity table on WACC x terminal growth.

Run it with:

    python3 company_dcf_valuation_model.py

All monetary figures are in $ millions unless otherwise stated.  Value per
share is in dollars.  This is an educational model for illustration only and
is not investment advice.
"""

# ======================================================================
# ASSUMPTIONS  (edit this section to value a different company)
# ======================================================================

BASE = {
    # ---- Explicit forecast period (years 1..5) -----------------------
    "revenue_0": 100.0,          # last historical year revenue ($M)
    "growth_rates": [0.12, 0.11, 0.10, 0.09, 0.08],
    "ebit_margins": [0.13, 0.14, 0.15, 0.16, 0.17],
    "tax_rate": 0.25,            # cash tax rate on EBIT

    # ---- Cash-flow drivers (as % of revenue unless noted) ------------
    "da_pct_revenue": 0.030,                 # depreciation & amortisation
    "capex_pct_revenue": 0.045,              # capital expenditure
    "nwc_pct_incremental_revenue": 0.20,     # NWC build on revenue growth

    # ---- WACC inputs -------------------------------------------------
    "risk_free": 0.040,          # 10-year government bond yield
    "beta": 1.15,                # levered equity beta
    "equity_risk_premium": 0.050,
    "cost_of_debt_pretax": 0.055,
    "equity_weight": 0.75,
    "debt_weight": 0.25,

    # ---- Terminal value & capital structure --------------------------
    "terminal_growth": 0.025,    # perpetuity growth rate
    "cash": 12.0,                # excess cash on balance sheet ($M)
    "debt": 40.0,                # total interest-bearing debt ($M)
    "shares": 12.5,              # diluted shares outstanding (millions)
}


# ======================================================================
# CALCULATIONS
# ======================================================================

def cost_of_equity(p):
    """CAPM: ke = risk-free + beta * equity risk premium."""
    return p["risk_free"] + p["beta"] * p["equity_risk_premium"]


def wacc(p, discount_override=None):
    """Weighted average cost of capital (or an override discount rate)."""
    if discount_override is not None:
        return discount_override
    ke = cost_of_equity(p)
    kd_after_tax = p["cost_of_debt_pretax"] * (1.0 - p["tax_rate"])
    return p["equity_weight"] * ke + p["debt_weight"] * kd_after_tax


def project_fcfs(p):
    """Project five years of revenue, EBIT and unlevered free cash flow."""
    rows = []
    revenue = p["revenue_0"]
    for year, (g, margin) in enumerate(
            zip(p["growth_rates"], p["ebit_margins"]), start=1):
        revenue_prev = revenue
        revenue = revenue_prev * (1.0 + g)
        ebit = revenue * margin
        nopat = ebit * (1.0 - p["tax_rate"])
        da = revenue * p["da_pct_revenue"]
        capex = revenue * p["capex_pct_revenue"]
        nwc_change = p["nwc_pct_incremental_revenue"] * (revenue - revenue_prev)
        ufcf = nopat + da - capex - nwc_change
        rows.append({
            "year": year,
            "revenue": revenue,
            "ebit": ebit,
            "nopat": nopat,
            "da": da,
            "capex": capex,
            "nwc_change": nwc_change,
            "ufcf": ufcf,
        })
    return rows


def run_valuation(p, discount_override=None, terminal_growth_override=None):
    """Run the full DCF and return a dictionary of results."""
    rows = project_fcfs(p)
    rate = wacc(p, discount_override)
    g = p["terminal_growth"] if terminal_growth_override is None else terminal_growth_override
    if g >= rate:
        raise ValueError("Terminal growth must be below the discount rate.")

    pv_fcfs = [row["ufcf"] / (1.0 + rate) ** row["year"] for row in rows]
    last_fcf = rows[-1]["ufcf"]
    terminal_value = last_fcf * (1.0 + g) / (rate - g)
    pv_terminal_value = terminal_value / (1.0 + rate) ** len(rows)

    enterprise_value = sum(pv_fcfs) + pv_terminal_value
    equity_value = enterprise_value + p["cash"] - p["debt"]
    per_share = equity_value / p["shares"]

    first_ebitda = rows[0]["ebit"] + rows[0]["da"]

    return {
        "rows": rows,
        "discount_rate": rate,
        "terminal_growth": g,
        "pv_fcfs": pv_fcfs,
        "sum_pv_fcfs": sum(pv_fcfs),
        "terminal_value": terminal_value,
        "pv_terminal_value": pv_terminal_value,
        "enterprise_value": enterprise_value,
        "equity_value": equity_value,
        "per_share": per_share,
        "ev_revenue_y1": enterprise_value / rows[0]["revenue"],
        "ev_ebitda_y1": enterprise_value / first_ebitda,
    }


# ======================================================================
# REPORTING
# ======================================================================

def print_report(res, p, label="Base case"):
    """Print the full DCF valuation report for one scenario."""
    rows = res["rows"]
    rate = res["discount_rate"]
    print("\n" + "=" * 96)
    print("DCF VALUATION REPORT  -  {}".format(label))
    print("=" * 96)

    ke = cost_of_equity(p)
    kd_after_tax = p["cost_of_debt_pretax"] * (1.0 - p["tax_rate"])
    print("\n--- WACC build-up ---")
    print("  Cost of equity (CAPM)          : {:>7.2%}".format(ke))
    print("  Cost of debt (after tax)       : {:>7.2%}".format(kd_after_tax))
    print("  WACC                           : {:>7.2%}".format(rate))

    print("\n--- Five-year projection ($M) ---")
    print("{:>5} {:>11} {:>11} {:>11} {:>10} {:>10} {:>10} {:>11}".format(
        "Year", "Revenue", "EBIT", "NOPAT", "+D&A", "-CapEx", "-dNWC", "UFCF"))
    for row in rows:
        print("{:>5} {:>11,.2f} {:>11,.2f} {:>11,.2f} {:>10,.2f} "
              "{:>10,.2f} {:>10,.2f} {:>11,.2f}".format(
                  row["year"], row["revenue"], row["ebit"], row["nopat"],
                  row["da"], row["capex"], row["nwc_change"], row["ufcf"]))

    print("\n--- DCF bridge ($M) ---")
    print("  Sum of PV of UFCF (years 1-5)  : {:>11,.2f}".format(res["sum_pv_fcfs"]))
    print("  Terminal value (year 5, g={:.1%})".format(res["terminal_growth"]))
    print("    Terminal value               : {:>11,.2f}".format(res["terminal_value"]))
    print("    PV of terminal value         : {:>11,.2f}".format(res["pv_terminal_value"]))
    print("  Enterprise value               : {:>11,.2f}".format(res["enterprise_value"]))
    print("  Less: net debt (debt - cash)   : {:>11,.2f}".format(p["debt"] - p["cash"]))
    print("  Equity value                   : {:>11,.2f}".format(res["equity_value"]))
    print("  Diluted shares (millions)      : {:>11,.2f}".format(p["shares"]))
    print("  Value per share ($)            : {:>11,.2f}".format(res["per_share"]))
    print("\n--- Implied valuation multiples (using year-1 figures) ---")
    print("  EV / Revenue (Y1)              : {:>10.2f}x".format(res["ev_revenue_y1"]))
    print("  EV / EBITDA (Y1)               : {:>10.2f}x".format(res["ev_ebitda_y1"]))


def print_scenarios():
    """Best / Base / Worst scenario comparison with probability weighting."""
    print("\n" + "=" * 96)
    print("SCENARIO ANALYSIS")
    print("=" * 96)
    print("  Best : faster growth (16-12%), margins to 20%, g = 3.0%")
    print("  Base : reference assumptions above,              g = 2.5%")
    print("  Worst: slower growth (6-4%),  margins to 13%,    g = 2.0%")

    best = dict(BASE)
    best["growth_rates"] = [0.16, 0.15, 0.14, 0.13, 0.12]
    best["ebit_margins"] = [0.16, 0.17, 0.18, 0.19, 0.20]
    best["terminal_growth"] = 0.030

    worst = dict(BASE)
    worst["growth_rates"] = [0.06, 0.06, 0.05, 0.05, 0.04]
    worst["ebit_margins"] = [0.10, 0.11, 0.12, 0.12, 0.13]
    worst["terminal_growth"] = 0.020

    scenarios = [
        (0.25, "Worst case", worst),
        (0.50, "Base case ", BASE),
        (0.25, "Best case ", best),
    ]

    print("\n{:>13} {:>13} {:>13} {:>12} {:>13}".format(
        "Scenario", "EV ($M)", "Equity ($M)", "$/share", "EV/EBITDA"))
    weighted_ps = 0.0
    for prob, name, params in scenarios:
        res = run_valuation(params)
        weighted_ps += prob * res["per_share"]
        print("{:>13} {:>13,.2f} {:>13,.2f} {:>12,.2f} {:>13,.2f}".format(
            name, res["enterprise_value"], res["equity_value"],
            res["per_share"], res["ev_ebitda_y1"]))
    print("-" * 96)
    print("{:>13} {:>13} {:>13} {:>12,.2f}".format(
        "Probability-weighted", "", "", weighted_ps))


def print_sensitivity(p):
    """Two-way sensitivity of equity value per share to WACC x terminal g."""
    growths = [0.015, 0.020, 0.025, 0.030, 0.035]
    rates = [0.070, 0.075, 0.080, 0.085, 0.090, 0.095]

    print("\n" + "=" * 96)
    print("SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS - Equity value per share ($)")

    print("  Base case sits at WACC 8.34% x terminal growth 2.5% "
          "(value {:.2f})".format(run_valuation(p)["per_share"]))
    print("\n{:>11}  {}".format("WACC \\ g", "".join(
        "{:>11}".format("{:.1%}".format(g)) for g in growths)))
    for r in rates:

        for g in growths:

                                       terminal_growth_override=g)["per_share"])
        print("{:>11}  {}".format("{:.2%}".format(r),
                                  "".join("{:>11,.2f}".format(v) for v in cells)))


# ======================================================================

# ======================================================================

def main():
